text:
Alice M: Heads-up — SDK v2.3 cutoff is tomorrow 4pm PT. We need explicit owners for sample apps, quickstarts, and the changelog cut. Pinging @Ben C @Carla L @devex-qa. Please confirm who will take what and any blockers.

Ben C: I can own sample apps. Planning to open PRs for node + python quickstarts today. ETA ~3pm PT. If anyone wants to pair on test failures ping me.

Carla L: I’ll own the changelog and release notes. Need a short list of consumer-facing changes from eng-runtime (esp KV cache/streaming note). @Ethan R can you confirm the KV cache perf note is safe to mention?

Ethan R: Confirmed — perf fix merged in PR #542, no contract changes, just internal timer optimization. Will drop a one-liner. Link: https://git.internal/r/infr/eng-runtime/pull/542

devex-qa: Quick reminder: QA preflight matrix for sampleapps is Node16 + Py3.11. Run the smoke harness and mark results. Command we use:```bash
make smoke
./scripts/run_smoke.sh --suite=sampleapps
```Please tag results with `/qa pass` or `/qa fail` in the PR.

Dana S: Docs freeze is at cutoff as well — I’ll review the quickstarts for API changes. Please tag docs-related PRs with `docs:review` so I can find them quickly.

Ben C: PRs created: https://git.internal/r/devex/sdk-node/pull/181 and https://git.internal/r/devex/sdk-py/pull/232. Node PR updates the example to use `stream=true` by default. @Alice M can you give a quick 👍 on packaging bump (setup.cfg)?

Alice M: On it. Quick note — make sure sample apps highlight the new `stream` behavior and show the streaming handler snippet. Also add a short comment about backward compatibility (sync mode still supported).

Carla L: Draft changelog bullets:
- SDK: default streaming flag set for sample quickstarts (clarify sync compatibility)
- Runtime: KV cache perf fix (no API change) — see eng-runtime#542
- Docs: updated quickstart examples for Node/Python streaming
I put the full draft in the changelog PR: https://git.internal/r/devex/changelog/pull/97

Alice M: Good. If we hit any test blockers, escalate to #devex-shiproom. Otherwise plan: Dana + Carla + Ben to approve by 3:30pm PT, I’ll merge and kick the canary deploy. :rocket:

release-bot: Canary deploy scheduled at 17:00 PT if all checks pass. Automated rollback on failing smoke.

Ben C: Will post `/qa pass` once CI + smoke finish.

devex-qa: Noted — I’ll run an additional quick run on the sampleapps after merges (takes ~15m).

Alice M: Thanks everyone — ping here if anything slips.
